name: Urgency Indicators
summary: Passive text-complete commercial signal with an explicit target-backed claim type, an optional decorative cue, strict invalid omission, and no neutral runtime.

anatomy.name: cue
anatomy.description: Optional decorative type-appropriate dot or icon that reinforces but never communicates or verifies the claim.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Non-empty visible localized wording that completely communicates the target-backed claim.

variants.name: low-stock
variants.description: Warning-family presentation for a truthful low-stock claim; the required semantic property prevents this technical registry default marker from becoming a runtime claim default.

variants.name: selling-fast
variants.description: Warning-family presentation for a truthful selling-fast claim without treating promotional pressure as Error or Critical feedback.

variants.name: viewers
variants.description: Neutral presentation for a truthful current-viewer claim.

variants.name: recent-sale
variants.description: Neutral presentation for a truthful recent-sale claim.

states.name: default
states.description: Valid non-empty passive claim with an explicitly selected type, optional decorative cue, and no focus, interaction, live region, motion, controlled state, or neutral runtime.

behavior.name: truthfulTargetData
behavior.description: The target supplies one already-qualified localized message and semantic claim type under ADR 0252; the source contract performs no inventory, velocity, session, sale-event, freshness, privacy, polling, expiry, or runtime-default work.

properties.name: message
properties.unsetBehavior: Trim the value and omit the complete component when the visible message is empty.
properties.description: Non-empty visible localized statement that completely communicates the target-backed claim without its decorative cue.

properties.name: variant
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete component when no valid explicit claim type is supplied; never fall back to low-stock at runtime.
properties.description: Explicit semantic claim type selected from target data; required so the contract does not infer an urgency default.

accessibility: Render one native paragraph with a required non-empty visible message and explicit valid claim type; omit invalid or blank composition.
Communicate the complete claim in visible text and hide every optional redundant cue from assistive technology.
Do not add alert, status, live-region, focus, keyboard, pointer, dismissal, or interaction semantics to the passive base.
Author no animation or transition; reduced motion causes no change because the component has no motion.
Permit long, localized, RTL, unbroken, and enlarged messages to wrap without clipping, truncation, overlap, or visual reordering.
Do not expose unverified or stale inventory, sales-velocity, viewer-count, or recent-sale claims; target truth and freshness are render preconditions.

web.notes: Implemented as a conditionally rendered native paragraph with named decorative cue/message parts, complete semantic typography, intrinsic containment, explicit claim type, strict omission, zero motion/live behavior, and zero neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: A target adapter is deferred until that target documents and proves the ADR 0252 authoritative source, claim qualification, selected-variant/market scope where applicable, refresh/expiry, privacy, placement, and stale/error omission behavior.
